title: Roadmap to Advanced SQL Interview Problems
description: A guided path from beginner SQL concepts to advanced LeetCode-style SQL problems.

modules.title: Salary Comparison by Department
modules.goal: Learn aggregation, joins, CASE WHEN, CTEs, and company-vs-group comparisons.
modules.boss_problem_title: Compare Department Average Salary vs Company Average

modules.title: Quiet Students
modules.goal: Learn min/max logic, subqueries, and exclusion patterns for exam results.

modules.title: Human Traffic of Stadium
modules.goal: Learn consecutive row patterns with ROW_NUMBER and grouping tricks.
modules.boss_problem_title: Find 3 or More Consecutive High-Traffic Rows

modules.title: Number of Transactions per Visit
modules.goal: Learn LEFT JOIN, zero-count rows, COALESCE, and count buckets.
modules.boss_problem_title: Count Visits by Number of Transactions

modules.title: Report Contiguous Dates
modules.goal: Learn continuous date interval grouping with ROW_NUMBER.

modules.title: Sales by Day of Week
modules.goal: Learn date extraction and pivot-style conditional aggregation.
modules.boss_problem_title: Report Units Sold per Category by Weekday

modules.title: Department Top 3 Salaries
modules.goal: Learn ranking functions and top-N-per-group queries.
modules.boss_problem_title: Find Top 3 Salaries in Each Department

modules.title: Restaurant Growth / Moving Average
modules.goal: Learn date aggregation, moving windows, and complete-window filtering.

modules.title: Shortest Distance in a Plane
modules.goal: Learn pair generation and distance calculations with SQL.
modules.boss_problem_title: Find the Shortest Distance Between Points

modules.title: Consecutive Numbers
modules.goal: Learn LAG and LEAD for comparing neighboring rows.
